extension_description.message: A quiet search box and an independent browsing window. Look something up, then close it.

intent_search.message: Uses your default Chrome search engine

intent_url.message: Open a website in its own window

history_empty.message: Your last five lookups will appear here.

history_local.message: Only lookups made here. Stored on this device.

eyebrow.message: A LITTLE MOMENT ON THE WEB

lead.message: A quick search box and a separate window for the web. Enter a query or URL, press Enter, then close the window when you are done.

step_one.message: Pin Little Window in Chrome’s toolbar, then click its icon to open a search window.

step_two.message: For a global shortcut, open Keyboard shortcuts below, choose your own unused combination, and set its scope to Global.

step_three.message: No shortcut is assigned on a fresh install. Chrome must stay running for a global shortcut to work.

shortcut_status.message: Primary: {primary}. Alternate: {fallback}. Check that the scope is Global on the shortcut settings page.

shortcut_failed.message: Could not read shortcuts. Check chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

shortcut_open_failed.message: Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts in the address bar to configure a shortcut.

usage_text.message: The search box and browsing window remember their last position and size separately. Resize or move either one as you like. Esc closes the search box; {closeKey} closes a web window. Existing web windows stay open when you start another lookup.

history_text.message: Only successful submissions from Little Window are saved, on this device. Click a recent item to reopen it; remove items individually or clear them all. This does not read or delete Chrome’s browsing history.

privacy_text.message: No analytics, account, or remote code. Searches go to your default search engine. Web pages use your current Chrome profile and can create normal browsing history. Closing a window does not make it private browsing. The extension is unavailable in incognito mode.

shortcut_note.message: System, browser, and other apps’ shortcuts can take priority. Use a different combination from Chrome’s native desktop search. This extension cannot override a reserved shortcut.

error_input.message: Enter a search or a web address.

error_empty.message: Type something you would like to look up.

error_too_long.message: That is too long. Shorten it and try again.

error_scheme.message: Only http and https websites can be opened.

error_url.message: That address looks incomplete. Please check it.

error_credentials.message: Use a web address without a username or password.

error_open.message: The window could not open. Please try again.

error_language.message: Choose one of the available languages.

error_history.message: This recent item is unavailable. Please try again.

error_generic.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.

error_stale.message: This search window is no longer available. Open a new one.

error_operation.message: This action is unavailable. Please reopen the window.
